instruction: A candid cinematic still shot at eye-level captures a couple on a rocky coastal shore next to the sea under an overcast sky. In the foreground, the blonde woman in a striped sweater (R2) stands with her arms crossed and eyes closed in a peaceful smile. Behind her, the bearded man with glasses in a blue puffer vest (R1) wraps his arms around her waist in a gentle embrace from behind, his eyes also closed. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused natural light, emphasizing the cool, muted tones of the coastal environment.
